This temporary post verifies that the whole website can be rendered in **one Quarto invocation** after `pixi exec` resolves packages declared in a document's YAML header. It is intended for the refactoring branch only.

## R: spatial neighborhood weights

```{r}
cat("R:", R.version.string, "\n")
stopifnot(requireNamespace("spdep", quietly = TRUE))
neighbors <- spdep::cell2nb(nrow = 2, ncol = 2, type = "rook")
weights <- spdep::nb2listw(neighbors, style = "W")
cat("spdep:", as.character(packageVersion("spdep")), "\n")
cat("Neighbor counts:", paste(spdep::card(neighbors), collapse = ", "), "\n")
stopifnot(length(weights$neighbours) == 4L)
stopifnot(all(spdep::card(neighbors) == 2L))
```

## Python: graph topology

```{python}
import sys
import networkx as nx

graph = nx.grid_2d_graph(2, 2)
print("Python:", sys.version.split()[0])
print("NetworkX:", nx.__version__)
print("Grid:", graph.number_of_nodes(), "nodes and", graph.number_of_edges(), "edges")
assert graph.number_of_nodes() == 4
assert graph.number_of_edges() == 4
```

Successful execution confirms that both declared extra packages were resolved inside the shared, temporary Pixi environment.
